c1.evidence: Offer: Serve as a Precinct Election Official (PEO) for Clermont County, OH Board of Elections on Election Day.

c2.evidence: Requirements: Be a properly registered voter of Clermont County; must attend training class and have transportation to the polls on Election Day morning.

c3.evidence: Payout: $133.72 for Election Day service, plus $75 for completing in-person training (training pay only if the worker also works Election Day).

c4.evidence: Time required: At the polls no later than 5:45 a.m. on Election Day; polls open 6:30 a.m. and close 7:30 p.m.; finished about 8:00 p.m. or possibly later. Approximately 14+ hours.

s1.note: Pay is a fixed per-election schedule set by the county Board of Elections: $133.72 for Election Day service plus $75 for completing in-person training (training pay requires working Election Day).

s2.note: PEOs must be at the polls no later than 5:45 a.m. on Election Day; polls run 6:30 a.m.-7:30 p.m.; wrap-up lasts until about 8:00 p.m. or possibly later.

s3.note: Attending the training class is a requirement; in-person training earns $75 in addition to Election Day pay.

s4.note: Clermont County elections are county-run; precinct election officials are appointed and paid by the county Board of Elections.

s5.note: The county reports PEOs prepare the precinct by setting up voting equipment, greet and check in voters, verify registration and ID, issue correct ballots, and close the precinct and prepare ballots and materials for delivery back to the Board of Elections on election night.

s6.note: Eligibility is standard: must be a registered voter of Clermont County, be able to attend training, have transportation to the polls on Election Day morning, and have no felony conviction under Ohio law.

s7.note: No guaranteed extra payout beyond the posted schedule; Election Day pay is a fixed $133.72 per election and training pay a fixed $75.
